regime_context: The detector shows a narrow leadership concentration (4 of 17 themes eligible) with Banks (H + HK) firmly leading (score 1.417, durability 0.67) over challenger Diversified Miners (score 1.033, margin 0.384). Rotation view is 'narrow' and not directional, with no one-narrative dominance. Most themes are ineligible and every theme lacks an ETF proxy except China Tech & Internet and China Platform Megacaps (both scorable, both at bottom-5 ranks), so this note is heavily constrained to unscorable themes.
emerging_watch: Watching Diversified Miners at rank 2 (score 1.033, hurst 'trend') as a possible leadership challenge to Banks, but the detector marks it ineligible — the observable to retire this watch is Diversified Miners crossing into eligible status while Banks loses the top rank or falls below a 0.2 score margin.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks sit at rank 1 with the strongest momentum score and a durable breadth profile (breadth 0.769, durability 0.67), the trend-gate leg supports staying power, and it is not crowded (crowding_z 0.79, crowded false). The absolute-trend gate is the only validated edge here; Banks clears that gate as eligible, while the cross-sectional rank itself is just a focus lens. Overweight on the trend-discipline leg, not on momentum as return forecast.
evidence: rank 1, score 1.417, eligibility true via absolute-trend gate
crowding_z 0.79, crowded false (no size-down red flag)
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is 'mixed' rather than 'trend', and the margin over challenger Diversified Miners (0.384) is thin enough that leadership could stall without a confirmed handoff. If rate or property-asset concerns hit HK banks broadly, the single-theme concentration works against this view.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) loses its eligible status (trend-gate flag flips off) before the 30-trading-day check-by

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips is the only other eligible theme with a coherent trend profile (hurst 'trend', durability 0.65, breadth 0.625) and is not crowded. It offers a slower, income-style complement to the Banks leadership rather than a competing rotation bet. The trend-gate leg supports it; no momentum alpha is claimed from rank 3.
theses.dissent: Its score is far below Banks (0.807 vs 1.417) and in a narrow-rotation, rate-sensitive HK tape it may simply track the same financial-led macro impulse without independent leadership. The lower absolute score offers no momentum cushion if the regime shifts.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips drops from eligible to ineligible (trend-gate flag flips off) before the 21-trading-day check-by

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
